subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: The Future of Last Mile
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Future of Last Mile.

hook.text: Drones overhead, robots on sidewalks, EVs on streets, and lockers on every corner. That's 2035.

buildup.text: The future last mile will blend autonomous vehicles, drones, lockers, and human drivers for different needs.

discovery.text: AI will route each package to the cheapest, fastest, greenest delivery method automatically.

twist.text: No single technology will dominate. The winner is the orchestrator who blends them all seamlessly.

climax.text: Companies investing in multi-modal last-mile networks now will own the delivery experience of the future.

punchline.text: The last mile won't have one solution. It'll have many.

quiz.question: What will future last-mile delivery rely on?
options: A blend of autonomous vehicles, drones, lockers, and drivers
